sample_unit: cases (whole slide images: 402 training, 185 external validation)

links.outcome: AUC on development data versus external dataset for AIH diagnosis from whole slide images
links.effect: AUC 0.92 ± 0.02 on training data fell to 0.74 on the external dataset; subgroup AUC ranged from 0.98 vs MASH to 0.42 vs Hepatitis B Virus. Prospective AUC was 0.73.
links.quote: achieved an AUC of 0,92 ± 0,02 on the training dataset and an AUC of 0,74 on the external dataset

screen.reason: Evaluates a deep-learning pathology diagnostic model prospectively in a real-life clinical setting alongside external retrospective validation, but focuses on model diagnostic accuracy without evaluating a deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
